description: Compare up to 10 GTIN barcodes at once and calculate the cheapest split-merchant basket vs. best single-merchant basket (including delivery). When any item has unverified delivery, total_landed_price is null (landed_price_status: 'incomplete_delivery_tbc'), known_landed_subtotal holds the known-cost subtotal, and savings are marked provisional.
name: compare_batch
title: Compare Multi-Item Basket
